snippet.title: TRAILER CRIMANIMALS
snippet.description:
Crimanimals is a puzzle and escape game where you play as a gang of animal thieves. Your goal: make your way through a series of dangerous rooms to steal the legendary golden can of tuna. But be careful… one wrong move could be your last.

Interactive puzzles: examine objects, combine clues, and find creative solutions to progress through each room. Nothing is what it seems, and even harmless objects can turn deadly.

Solo or co-op play: experience the challenge on your own or team up with friends online. Work together to solve puzzles… or accidentally trigger a trap.

Choose your criminal animal: pick your favorite character and take part in the most absurd heist of the century.

Every attempt matters: fail a puzzle and you may not get a second chance. Will you escape with the prize, or fall victim to the traps along the way?

#indiegame
